claims.claim: one windy day piled almost 1 % of Oneida Lake's estimated perch egg potential into a single windrow (Clady & Hutchinson 1975, abstract)
claims.note: the abstract says a single large windrow, just downwind of a major spawning area, "contained almost one percent of the estimated egg potential"; eggs were washed ashore at a number of windward locations, and damage was worst over rubble. The paper's sentence matches the abstract and already says so

claims.claim: one storm day stranded ~1 % of the lake's perch eggs (assigned to the shallow third of them [inf])
claims.note: per the abstract the ~1 % is ONE windrow's share of the egg POTENTIAL (a fecundity-based estimate, not eggs actually laid), while eggs washed ashore at several locations; so the day's total stranding was larger than 1 % and its base differs. Needs the full text before the storm loss rate is tied to it
